sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् ।
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम ॥ ४-३१॥
iast:
yajñaśiṣṭāmṛtabhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṃ loko’styayajñasya kuto’nyaḥ kurusattama 4-31
translation: The eaters of the nectar — remnant of the sacrifice — go to the Eternal BRAHMAN. Even this world is not for the non-performer of sacrifice; how then the other (world) , O best of the Kurus?
